source_findings: Horizon transport has bounded timeouts and retries but no strict-send/strict-receive path implementation was found
current payment and batch transaction builders encode mock strings as base64 instead of real Stellar XDR
current generic payment signer is mock and includes a secret-key prefix in the constructed string
current tx send amount and XLM balance safety checks use f64
real Stellar XDR, signature payload, Ed25519 and Ledger signing primitives already exist in signer_rotation/xdr.rs
private atomic 0600 file writes already exist in signer_rotation/store.rs
confirmation/budget UX is reusable but a refreshed quote or rebuilt body must invalidate prior confirmation
current retry scaffolding can rebuild sequence/fee and must not silently mutate a confirmed path-payment transaction
Trezor is not a proven signing capability through the current generic hardware abstraction

architecture.route_ranking: lexicographic exact amount + policy penalty + hop count + stable path key
architecture.slippage: strict-send dest_min floor; strict-receive send_max ceil; checked integer basis points
architecture.freshness: local quote TTL plus immutable quote/policy/network digests; refresh requires reconfirmation
architecture.signing: software plus proven hardware capability; verify body unchanged after signing
architecture.offline: versioned private atomic unsigned bundle with quote/plan/body digests and no secrets
architecture.submission: no body-mutating automatic retry after confirmation
architecture.ci: deterministic mocks/fixtures; no mandatory live Horizon
